# Guitar Setup Lab

Interactive guitar setup diagnostics, measurement helpers, pickup fit and spacing checks, luthier geometry planners, calibrated print templates, and shop records.

- Tools use safety-first, measurement-led workflows.
- Pickup fit tools use current user-entered dimensions and never authorize routing or drilling.
- Geometry templates require physical print calibration before use.
- No result is a physical inspection or guaranteed repair diagnosis.
- Contact: canghun13@naver.com
